result.title: Gradient Boosting for Efficient Rank Discovery in Tensor Network Kernel Machines
result.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Code available at: https://github.com/AlbMLpy/boosting-tnkm
result.summary: Tensor network kernel machines (TNKMs) combine nonlinear features with low-rank tensor representations to model complex relationships efficiently. However, selecting an appropriate tensor rank remains challenging, as conventional rank-search methods require training multiple candidate models, increasing computational costs. In this work, we focus on a canonical polyadic (CP) tensor network parameterization and propose GB-CPKM, a gradient boosting framework that builds a higher-capacity predictor by sequentially adding fixed-rank learners. This approach provides a new perspective on rank selection by incrementally increasing model capacity, with ensemble size selected based on validation performance rather than through explicit rank search. Experiments on real-world regression benchmarks show that GB-CPKM trains up to 6x faster and uses up to 2x less peak memory than a conventional rank-selection method based on cross-validation, while achieving comparable predictive performance. These results highlight the potential of gradient boosting to improve the computational efficiency and scalability of tensor-network learning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GB-CPKM，用 gradient boosting 依次叠加固定秩的 CP 张量网络学习器来提升模型容量，并以验证集表现决定集成规模，从而回避显式的张量秩搜索；在回归基准上比交叉验证式秩搜索训练更快、峰值内存更低而预测性能相当。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「按需逐步增加容量、以验证表现决定何时停止」的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 STOP 决策的设计提供可供核查的类比思路。
